entries.note: The sender's pre-advice of the parcel is in: nothing handed over yet.
The sender downloaded the label, with how many times: paperwork that moves nothing.
Taken in at the Polish warehouse.
The parcel paid for: an account notice that moves nothing.

entries.wording: 荷兰仓库 仓库揽收完成，等待仓库操作
entries.note: Taken in at the Dutch warehouse, waiting to be handled there.

entries.wording: 仓库扫描称重完毕，等待组批次
entries.note: Scanned and weighed at the warehouse, waiting to be put in a batch.

entries.wording: 包裹完成组批次，等待出库
entries.note: Put in a batch, waiting to leave the warehouse.

entries.wording: 司机已装车，卡车送往机场途中
entries.note: Loaded on the truck to the airport.

entries.wording: 包裹已经送达荷兰阿姆斯特丹机场，航班即将飞行中
entries.note: At Amsterdam airport for the flight to China.

entries.wording: 包裹到达清关口岸，等待监管车提货
entries.note: Landed at the Chinese port of entry, waiting for the bonded truck to the customs warehouse.

entries.wording: 包裹已申报，等待海关清关
entries.note: Declared to Chinese customs, waiting for clearance.
Handed to the courier in China the second it clears customs; that courier's own rows, a delivery round among them, follow for days, so it is not the delivery round.
Signed for. Parcel100 may close the parcel weeks after the courier's own delivery row.
